info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Parking Reservations Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservations Status API provides vital information about the current status of parking reservations. This API allows users to query the status of multiple parking reservations efficiently, enabling quick access to reservation details. Typical consumers include parking operators and management systems that need to monitor and manage parking availability. It supports use cases such as tracking reservations, managing occupancy, and providing real-time updates to customers and staff.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of a reservation.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to check the current status of their reservations by providing the necessary identification details. It provides insights into whether the reservation is confirmed, pending, or canceled.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving the status of reservations. This should contain the necessary parameters to specify which reservation's status is being queried.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the current status of reservations.
